summary: Locked curl (8.12.1-4.el10) at its current version on node1 using dnf versionlock, confirmed a simulated system update excludes it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and versionlock state, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and verified post-restart that curl's version and the versionlock entry persisted with the system fully healthy.
actions_performed: Checked installed curl version and confirmed dnf as package manager on node1
Added versionlock for curl (curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*) on node1
Ran dnf check-update and a dry-run dnf upgrade --assumeno to confirm curl is excluded from updates (only libcurl, a separate package, appeared)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, curl version, versionlock list
Issued a non-blocking reboot (shutdown -r now backgrounded) so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again after the reboot
Verified changed boot_id and near-zero uptime as direct proof of restart
Verified post-restart curl version, versionlock persistence, and systemctl is-system-running health

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version (8.12.1-4.el10) via versionlock
evidence.summary: Baseline curl version 8.12.1-4.el10 identified; versionlock plugin installed; versionlock added for curl at that exact version

Dry-run dnf upgrade shows 250 packages to upgrade including libcurl but no curl entry; targeted grep for curl/versionlock/excluding in the upgrade plan returns no match, confirming curl package itself is not part of the update set
Captured boot_id deef5424-198c-4c8e-95f2-5cd8c8ea3f8d, curl version, and active versionlock entry before restart
Backgrounded shutdown -r now returned 'reboot_issued' immediately, then subsequent poll timed out confirming the node went down
Two polls failed (connection timeout, connection reset) while node was down; third poll succeeded with new boot_id 77ffbf46-483a-4168-8001-45830d5f16e9 and uptime 0 min, proving a genuine reboot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of curl version hold
evidence.summary: After restart, curl remains 8.12.1-4.el10, versionlock entry for curl still present, and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running'
